section_summary.extract_value: This section describes the Body Image Screening Questionnaire for Eating Disorder Early Detection (BISQ), a 24-item instrument measuring disordered eating symptoms across five dimensions (bulimia, anorexia, orthorexia, perception of obesity, and vigorexia). The authors note that while a Romanian translation exists, subscale internal consistency was inadequate, so they used an overall BISQ score with acceptable internal consistency (Cronbach's alpha = .82 for women and .80 for men in the present study). This section pertains to 'the present study' but does not explicitly identify it as Study 1 or provide other study-level demographic or statistical data.
